fields.label: Default Payment Type
fields.description: Cash and Bank invoices auto-create a Payment Entry on submit, into the Default Cash / Bank Account below (or the one the driver picks, when "Choose payment account" is on under Modules & Features).

fields.label: Allow Bank Payment
fields.description: Offer Bank (transfer / card into a bank account) besides Cash and Credit.

fields.label: Show Cash / Bank / Credit on Invoice
fields.description: When hidden, the app always uses the default payment type.

fields.label: Default Cash Account
fields.description: For drivers of this account's company, unless their VanSale Profile sets one. Empty = ERPNext Mode of Payment "Cash" default account.

fields.label: Default Bank Account
fields.description: For drivers of this account's company, unless their VanSale Profile sets one. Empty = the company's Bank-type Mode of Payment default account, then the Company's Default Bank Account.

fields.label: Allow Changing Warehouse
fields.description: Lets drivers sell from another warehouse of the same company. The default warehouse comes from the user's VanSale Profile, then ZG Company Settings, then ERPNext Stock Settings.

fields.label: Allow Orders (Invoice Later)
fields.description: Offer the Order option (a Sales Order converted to a tax invoice later) besides Invoice.

fields.label: Restrict Collections to Route
fields.description: When on, drivers can only collect from customers on their route (ZG Trip) or that they invoiced themselves. Turn off to let drivers collect from any customer.

fields.options: What the VanSaleX app offers on this site — one row per screen, in the app's order; "Where in the app" shows which tab or More-menu entry each row controls. Unticked entries disappear from the app and the server rejects them. A feature only works while its module is on. Settings (with Logout) is always shown. Orders, credit sales, bank payment, discount and warehouse change are controlled by the fields above. Per user: switch entries off on the user's ZG Van Sale Profile.

fields.label: Configuration Version
fields.description: Increases each time Modules & Features change.
